name: Parmanu
summary: Raj Comics' atomic hero: Delhi police inspector Vinay, whose bright yellow power suit lets him shrink, fly, teleport and fire atomic blasts. Parmanu means atom.
origin: As a high-school student, Vinay saw criminals murder a classmate and found out the killer was the city's police chief. When the chief came after him for the evidence, Vinay was rescued by his maternal uncle, the scientist Prof. K. K. Verma, who had built a costume that gives its wearer superpowers. In it, Vinay defeated the monster Bufalo and avenged his classmate. Most of his family died in the chaos, and his own brother Vijay sided with the gangsters. As an adult, Vinay serves in the Delhi Police by day and patrols as Parmanu by night.
powers: Flight at the speed of sound and beyond
Atomic bolts fired from his chest and wrist gadgets
Atomic rope from his wrist gadgets
Can break his body down into atoms
Voice-activated suit, upgraded by the robot Probot
City-wide camera network run by Probot

gossip.text: Parmanu is the Hindi word for atom, a nod to his atomic powers.
Commentators have compared his shrinking powers to Ant-Man and the Atom, and ThePrint's headline calls him both rolled into one.
Early on he activated his powers with buttons on his belt. Probot later made the suit respond to voice commands.
Parmanu is not a born superhero: his powers come entirely from the suit his uncle, Prof. K. K. Verma, built.
Sanjay Gupta says he came up with Parmanu in the late 1980s because he wanted a hero with scientific powers.

options: His uncle, Prof. K. K. Verma

facts.text: Wikipedia's Parmanu page says he dies in the Akhiri comic series, blasting himself in space to save Earth. The page carries a 'more citations needed' tag, so treat the detail with care.
The Akhiri series, called Aakhiri - The Last Survivors, began in 2015 with Akhiri Rakshak, meaning Last Defender. It pairs Super Commando Dhruva with Parmanu and runs to at least six parts.
One Parmanu comic is titled Meri Dress Vapas Kar, which means 'Give my costume back!'.
Many Parmanu titles are named after creatures and things: Makhhi means fly, Jonk is leech, Bichhu is scorpion, Kekda is crab and Lattoo is a spinning top.
Parmanu's enemies are an odd bunch: Vriksha (tree), Cactus, Neem Hakim, Itihaas (History), Programmer and even one called Principal, alongside Dr. Madagascar, General Kharonch, Holika and Madam Cold.
Probot, a robot, watches Delhi through cameras fitted around the city. It also upgraded the suit from belt buttons to voice recognition, so Parmanu triggers each power by calling its name.
Pralayanka, whose real name is Mamta Pathak, is a heroine who helps Parmanu. Like him, she is a creation of his scientist uncle, Prof. K. K. Verma.
Vinay first pulls on his uncle's suit as Wonderman Parmanu just as the monster Bufalo attacks the lab, so his very first fight as a hero is against a monster.
Raj Comics lists a Parmatma series starring Parmanu and an Aab Marega Parmanu series, whose title means roughly 'Now Parmanu will die'.
Raj Comics' Kaal Series teams Parmanu with Ashwaraj, Gojo, Bhokal, Tilismdev, Inspector Steel and Super Indian, and in the Mai Hu Bheriya series he joins Bheriya, Nagraj, Dhruva and Doga.
The 2013 multistarrer Sarvayugam gathered 16 Raj Comics heroes, including Dhruva, Nagraj, Doga, Tiranga, Shakti, Bhokal, Ashwaraj, Inspector Steel and Parmanu, in a single story.
Raj Comics' first special issue, Nagraj aur Super Commando Dhruva in 1991, put Parmanu among its guest heroes alongside Gagan, Vinashdoot, Monty, Chandika and the Commando Force.
In the 1998 special Soorma, Nagraj and Parmanu take on Dr. Virus, who says he moved his base from Rajnagar to Delhi because he feared Dhruva.
Comic Book Religion lists Parmanu's first appearance as Aag Comics #261 in 1991, gives his other names as Atom and Wonderman Parmanu, and counts 69 appearances.
A fan-site review of an early Parmanu comic shows him stopping a terrorist's escaping private plane by clamping it with an energy lasso made from his power-rays, forcing it to land.
In that review the terrorist Sapera hides in the Crystal building near Delhi's Qutub Minar, and police commandos surround it from a helicopter before Parmanu steps in.
The same early comic has the Sapera Group fire-bomb a police station and drop leaflets from helicopters threatening a rain of fire on Delhi if their leader is not freed.
Parmanu's suit lets him fly at the speed of sound and beyond, fire atomic bolts from his chest, reel out atomic rope, and shrink to any size, according to Wikipedia.
As a high-school student Vinay finds the murder weapon, a revolver, and learns the killer is the head of police, who then hunts him to get the gun back.
In an interview with ThePrint, Sanjay Gupta said a Parmanu film is worth considering and that the hero deserves a screen outing.

kidSummary: Parmanu is Raj Comics' atom hero. Delhi police inspector Vinay wears a bright yellow suit built by his uncle that lets him shrink, fly, teleport and fire atomic bolts.
